title: Make lesson start and Field Quest mission briefs act where the learner clicked

observed.section: Greet café staff and open the interaction politely

root_cause.start: beginLessonFor called startBoundLessonChat first. On this host session.create plus host.openSession focused a just-created session before it had a stored id, so the learner landed on a blank new-session screen with 'No durable chat yet'. The fresh run was armed, but no surface showed it.
root_cause.resume: The section offered a disabled Resume this section button and a Reattach button that called begin('resume') even when there was no durable chat. Both were dead ends.
root_cause.brief: Field Quest mission cards were read-only li elements. The authored brief was present, but clicking its heading or prose did nothing, so the cards read as decorative.

fixes: A fresh run now arms the exact lesson run first, then opens a new chat through the named openArmedLessonChat helper. CoursebookPane consumes the pending binder and names the exact run, objective and first-message action.

Removed the dead disabled Resume this section and Reattach controls. When no binding is active the section shows one Start a fresh run button plus a plain explanation; an active binding shows Continue here.

The Field Quest mission card is a role=link pointer and keyboard target. Clicking its heading or prose opens the same block in Textbook; nested Save to notebook and Read in Textbook controls keep their own behaviour.
Replaced detached-binding jargon and 'No durable chat yet' with plain next-step copy and an Open Coursebook action.
Field Quest intro now tells the learner that opening a mission shows its teaching in Textbook and that nothing is locked.

start.pane: Lesson run ready: Greet café staff and open the interaction politely

repair_context.h64_home_library: The h64 test home was repaired and its café course re-authored before this live check; its lessons were seeded through gen.run_lesson_job with the repository fixtures. H-71 records the matching test-home repair.
repair_context.note: This card fixes the interaction and copy; it does not add a semantic topic-identity validator. A generated plan can still be structurally valid while off-topic, which is a separate product decision.
